name: Yrax quadraphract
description: A gleaming, burnished gold, four legged structure the size of a small vehicle, but much taller; this looks vaguely robotic, but too smooth and perfect to fit in this world.  Its legs are smooth faceted figures, with no visible joints, and hold its gem-like body aloft with an eery, sculpted grace.  At the peak of the gem-body is a deep, goblet-shaped crown that slowly swivels about, pointing at nothing in specific.  Though nothing about its appearance is familiar to you, it nevertheless strikes you with a mixture of awe and dread.
//: A lot of gold in this bad boy.
//2: Takes at least two Carl Gustaff HEDP shells to kill.

special_attacks.description: reality seems to warp around the quadraphract's crown as it fires.

death_function.message: The quadraphract collapses, dead at last.

description: A morphing lune of burnished gold attached to the greater structure.  Seemingly jointless it moves with a fluid grace, allowing the quadraphract to glide aboveground with a speed and agility that belies its size.

death_function.message: The quadraphract stumbles as one of its legs looses coherence and collapses.
